titre: Synthesis Test n°2 — English (5th year primary)

exercices.enonce:
Reading - Comprehension
Read the text then answer the questions.

My name is Rania. My favourite day is Saturday. On Saturday, I do not go to school. In the morning, I play tennis with my father. I like sports very much. In the afternoon, I visit my grandmother. When the weather is sunny, we walk in the park. When it is rainy, we stay at home. In the evening, I read books and draw pictures. Saturday is a happy day for me.

Questions:
1) What is Rania's favourite day? (1 pt)
2) Does she go to school on Saturday? (1 pt)
3) What sport does she play with her father? (0.5 pt)
4) Who does she visit in the afternoon? (0.5 pt)
5) What do they do when the weather is sunny? (0.5 pt)
6) What does she do in the evening? (0.5 pt)

Days and weather
Complete or match:
a) The day after Friday is ....... .
b) The day after Saturday is ....... .
c) When the sun shines, the weather is ....... .
d) When it rains, the weather is ....... .

Sports and hobbies
Complete with: ( tennis - football - swim - draw )
a) I play ....... with a racket.
b) I play ....... with a ball.
c) I ....... in the sea.
d) I ....... pictures.

Grammar - Present simple
Complete with the correct verb:
a) I ....... (like) sports.
b) She ....... (play) tennis.
c) They ....... (read) books.

Writing
Write 3 sentences about your favourite day and what you do (a sport or a hobby).

Telling the time.
Look at the clocks and write the time in words.
1) Clock A -> ..........
2) Clock B -> ..........
